notes.title: New Update V01312024
notes.content:
[b]Greetings Skyline Sprinters![/b]

We're thrilled to bring you the latest update for your favorite racing adventure - Version V01312024 is now available!

What's New:

Fixed White Watch Tower Door Issue: We've addressed a pesky problem in the Hawaii map where players were having trouble entering the white watch tower. The door is now accessible, thanks to a resized collision that ensures a smoother experience.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/gyz8cvu.png[/img]

General Map Enhancements: Multiple maps have received some love! We've implemented various improvements to enhance the overall gaming experience. Keep an eye out for smoother terrains and more immersive landscapes.

Version Details:

Version: V01312024
Release Date: 01/31/2024

[u][b]How to Update:[/b][/u]
Reboot Steam if the game is not automatically updating to the newest version.

We appreciate your continued support and feedback. Feel free to share your thoughts on the update, and let us know if you encounter any issues. Your input is invaluable as we strive to make Skyline Sprinters the ultimate racing adventure!

Get ready to hit the roads with these exciting improvements. Buckle up, rev those engines, and race on!

Happy Sprinting!

Crimeenginegames.

notes.title: Skyline Sprinters Update: Improved Server Functionality and Gameplay
notes.content:
Hello Skyline Sprinters Community,

We're excited to share that a new update, packed with enhancements and optimizations, has arrived to elevate your gaming experience in Skyline Sprinters!

[b]Server Stability Improved:[/b]
This update resolves server-related issues that have been affecting gameplay. Say goodbye to those frustrating moments with smoother server functionality. Additionally, we've tackled the problem where servers occasionally failed to appear in the browsing section, ensuring that you always have access to available servers.

[b]Gameplay Adjustment:[/b]
We've made a significant change to the game's structure by removing the difficulty selection. Our aim is to provide a more immersive and progressive experience. As you progress through the maps, you'll now notice a natural increase in difficulty, starting from easier challenges and gradually ramping up the complexity. Get ready for an adventure that adapts to your skills and keeps you engaged as you conquer new levels.

We're committed to refining your Skyline Sprinters experience, ensuring smoother gameplay and a more enjoyable journey through the cityscape.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback. Your involvement is crucial as we strive to create the best possible gaming environment for all players.

Update your game now and dive into these improvements in Skyline Sprinters!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/VeRk0cU.jpg[/img]

Best regards,
Crimeenginegames.

notes.title: Skyline Sprinters Update: Version 0.01062024
notes.content:
[b]Greetings Skyline Sprinters Community![/b]

We're excited to introduce the latest update, Version 0.01062024, designed to enhance your gaming experience. This update addresses a crucial issue encountered when hosting a server without modifying the max player count. Previously, this defaulted to a setting of 50 players but effectively limited it to 2. We've rectified this discrepancy to ensure seamless server hosting and gameplay for all users.

In addition to this critical fix, we've implemented various minor adjustments and improvements across the game. Our team remains committed to refining and optimizing Skyline Sprinters to deliver the best gaming environment possible.
